title: FakeIDet3-DB: Refining Digital Attacks and Patch Extraction for Secure ID Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2607.26641v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Identity document (ID) authentication relies on the structural integrity of complex, high-frequency security patterns. However, advanced Generative AI models can now inject localized, high-fidelity manipulations, creating deceptive attacks that bypass standard verification. Training robust image forensic models to detect these anomalies is hindered by privacy regulations, forcing reliance on synthetic templates lacking the intricate visual patterns of real IDs. To bridge this domain gap, we introduce FakeIDet3-DB, the first comprehensive database of digital manipulations on real, government-issued IDs. FakeIDet3-DB encompasses classical (e.g., copy-move) and Generative AI-driven manipulations (e.g., face-swapping, inpainting) enhanced with advanced image refinement procedures to suppress visual artifacts. translated_abstract: 身份证件（ID）认证依赖于复杂、高频安全图案的结构完整性。然而，先进的生成式AI模型如今能够注入局部化、高保真的篡改，制造出可绕过标准验证的欺骗性攻击。由于隐私法规的限制，训练鲁棒的图像取证模型来检测这些异常面临阻碍，迫使研究者只能依赖缺乏真实证件复杂视觉图案的合成模板。为了弥合这一领域差距，我们推出了FakeIDet3-DB，这是首个针对真实政府签发证件的数字篡改综合数据库。FakeIDet3-DB涵盖了经典篡改手段（如复制-移动）以及生成式AI驱动的篡改（如换脸、图像修复），并通过先进的图像精化流程来抑制视觉伪影。此外，为了遵守严格的数据保护法规（如GDPR），我们采用了近期提出的一种基于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于真实政府签发证件构建的数字篡改数据库FakeIDet3-DB，涵盖经典篡改与生成式AI篡改并通过先进图像精化流程抑制视觉伪影，同时满足GDPR等严格数据保护法规的要求。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FakeIDet3-DB, the first comprehensive database of digital manipulations on real government-issued IDs, covering both classical and Generative AI-driven attacks with advanced image refinement to suppress visual artifacts, while complying with strict data protection regulations such as GDPR.
